repeated_kind_flag: 'quote does not support value' appears 6 times (>=3): sweep for (a) compound values carrying a clause the cited page lacks (ZIP, parent/product label, metals copied from sister-site postings, an address from an uncited query) and (b) line premises not on a cited stated row (Houston day shift x2).
method: Every cited page fetched 2026-11-19 with tools/fetch_page.py (raw source incl. JSON-LD; browser fallback for Workday); quotes split on '...' and matched after normalisation; files over 60k chars rechecked with --check/--grep untruncated (SEC 10-Q, accessnewswire, JobTarget, Workday). OSHA rows checked field by field against data/osha_2025.csv (osha.gov blocked). Live status and other site roles read from the Workday jobs API (cxs) per city. 1 web search used (Pittsburg expansion). Unknown rows without a quote were not counted.
